product_name: Fursten Belt Bag in Monogram Nylon
description: A mobile masterwork in monochrome, the Fursten belt bag in black Italian nylon and leather epitomizes the sleek design ethos of the Munich House. Enveloped in the signature Visetos monogram, the striking silhouette is defined by a trilogy of zipped compartments.

product_name: Klassik Briefcase in Visetos
description: An artisanal companion, crafted to elevate professional endeavors. This large briefcase in black Visetos features two ample zip compartments for sumptuous storage of documents, devices, and accessories. A leather hang tag accompanies the monogram silhouette in a nod to the travel heritage of the Munich House.

product_name: Aren Messenger Bag in Maxi Monogram Leather
description: The Aren messenger bag embodies the elevated craftsmanship and mobile mindset of the Haus. An upscaled iteration of classic codes, the Maxi monogram is imprinted on natural nappa leather in an expression of MCM maximalism. Front and rear pockets grant easy access to urgent essentials, while the main zip compartment is optimized for modern devices, accessories, and documents

product_name: Aren Backpack in Visetos
description: This novel backpack features a modern rectangular silhouette for optimal storage of laptops, tablets, and documents inside its soft microfiber suede interior. Modern utility rooted in heritage craftsmanship, it’s meticulously sculpted from signature Visetos and nappa leather.

product_name: Dia Shopper in Calfskin Leather
description: An artisanal companion with a Munich muse, the Dia shopper in calfskin leather is characterized by handle straps and side patches inspired by the Bavarian diamonds. Looking inward, emblematic artwork adorns the interior — featuring a removable pouch for another facet of functional brilliance.

product_name: Aren Crescent Hobo Bag in Maxi Monogram Leather
description: As exquisite as its lunar inspiration, this curvilinear hobo bag in Italian full-grain leather is imprinted with a maximalist interpretation of the renowned Visetos monogram. Carry by its chain handle or attach the accompanying leather strap for hands-free sophistication.

product_name: Diamond Logo Crossbody in Metallic Calfskin
description: A bold nod to our German birthplace, the distressed geometric design of metallic calf leather crossbody bag is modeled after the Bavarian diamonds of Munich. The signature Laurel logo is embossed on the front of the silhouette, further complemented by a diamond-inspired metal hardware handle and adjustable leather strap.

product_name: Skywander Boots in Calfskin
description: A Munich take on the classic Chelsea. These black calfskin leather boots feature an elastic side trim and logo-printed pull tab for ease of wear. The clean design is contrasted by the Skywander outsole, renowned for its signature 3D Laurel-and-Ribbon patterning.

product_name: Aren Shoulder Bag in Lambskin
description: Honoring South Korean culture, this small shoulder bag in lambskin leather features a two-tone colorway influenced by traditional Taekwondo uniforms. The special design of the leather strap references the belt straps of the martial arts ensemble.
category: Bags > Shoulder Bags & Pochettes > Shoulder Bag

product_name: Claus Fluted M Belt 1.5” in Grained Leather
description: The dark metal “M” buckle of this Claus belt features a multi-faceted fluted finish. Offering two looks in one accessory, the reversible wardrobe staple is sculpted from grained leather with an opposite side in signature Visetos canvas.

product_name: Ottomar Cabin Trolley in Visetos
description: Clad in classic cognac, the Ottomar cabin trolley re-envisions the art of luggage making through a modern lens. Masterfully crafted from Visetos canvas and leather, the monogram silhouette features an exterior laptop pocket as well as a compartmentalized interior for organization of the highest order.

product_name: Stark Packable Backpack in Monogram Nylon
description: Propelled forward by functional innovation, the Munich House presents this monochromatic Stark backpack featuring an advanced design allowing the silhouette to be transformed into a sleek pouch when not in use. A D-ring detail accompanies the conversion, allowing one to connect their preferred strap for hands-free wear.

product_name: Ottomar Passport Holder in Visetos
description: Crafted for the modern global nomad, the Ottomar passport holder epitomizes the jet-setting ethos of the Munich House. The bifold accessory features a supple leather interior with an optimal number of compartments for travel credentials and finances.

product_name: MCM x We The Best Logo Embroidery Polo
description: Woven from Merino wool and cashmere, this men’s knitted polo features a monochromatic aesthetic with tonal “MCM x We The Best” embroidery on the chest for a subtle infusion of iconography.

product_name: MCM x We The Best Ultrasuede Cap
description: Characterized by a splendidly soft quality courtesy of a Japanese ultrasuede composition, this cap features the collaborative “MCM x We The Best” logo in intricate embroidery. The back of the accessory is finished with an adjustable strap defined by a metal buckle design modeled after the Bavarian diamonds of Munich.

product_name: MCM x We The Best Ultrasuede Slides
description: These collaborative slides elevate a casual footwear staple through the artisanal materials and craftsmanship of the Munich House. The impeccably soft Japanese ultrasuede upper is marked by a minimalist aesthetic, while the logo-embellished footbed is defined by subtle graining for sublime comfort.

product_name: Bandana Monogram Print Petite Silk Scarf
description: Classic Americana is referenced through an ornate cowboy bandana-inspired graphic atop the Visetos monogram. Hand sewn from GOTS-certified organic Italian silk, the petite scarf can also be tied as a sweet bow or wrapped around the handles of your bag.

product_name: Mode Travia Loafers in Brushed Calfskin
description: Italian shoemaking expertise is expressed through a brushed calf leather upper, cognac calf leather lining, and lightweight Vibram® lug sole. The brass Mode Travia logo comprises the buckle, imbuing the pair with the structured splendor of the ringed emblem.

product_name: Year of the Snake Bouclé Cropped Hoodie
description: Knitted from soft Japanese bouclé, this oversized hoodie with a cropped length commemorates the Year of the Snake through a grained leather patch featuring the namesake zodiac animal. The bold motif is emblazoned with the signature Visetos monogram, showcasing classic codes through the immaculate leather craftsmanship of the Munich House.

product_name: Monogram Ripstop Nylon Puffer Jacket
description: Woven from Italian ripstop nylon, this hooded jacket is enveloped in the timeless splendor of the signature Visetos monogram. Insulated with recycled polyester, the padded silhouette fosters incredible warmth with respect to nature.

product_name: Pants in Denim Lurex
description: A lustrous rendition of a classic staple, these indigo denim pants feature a subtle sheen resulting from interwoven metallized lurex fibers. Heritage hardware enriches the pair through logo-engraved metal buttons and diamond studs, while a signature Visetos monogram patch at the back of the piece serves as a timeless punctuation mark.

product_name: Rabbit Doll in Visetos
description: It comes in rich coated canvas, refined with smooth seams and polished trims.

product_name: Pet Carrier in Monogram Nylon and Leather
description: Refined relaxation for animal companions on travels, this pet carrier is sculpted from Italian nylon with a sumptuous padded interior and breathable mesh panels. A timeless insignia of the Munich House, the signature Visetos monogram envelops the monochromatic silhouette. Dual exterior compartments secure the accessories and essentials of your canine and feline friends in style.

product_name: 13" iPad Case in Visetos Original
description: MCM's house codes span the surface of this padded case for your 13” iPad. Delve deeper and discover roomy interior compartments for your phone, cords, and chargers.

product_name: Key Pouch in Visetos Original
description: A sweet spin on a passionate colorway, the Candy Red line unifies scarlet Visetos and nappa leather on this compact pouch. The resulting accessory offers pure sensory delight with a focus on everyday usability. Attach this mobile companion to your larger accessories for an infusion of classic MCM flair and functionality.

product_name: Aren Fabric Tote
description: Presented in a premium Italian cotton-linen blend, the large Aren tote is crowned with the renowned Laurel emblem of the House. Contrasting white leather details, including a detachable Bavarian diamond charm, elevate the structured companion.

product_name: Federlite Sneakers in Laurel Suede Leather
description: Sculpted from premium Italian suede, the Federlite low-top sneaker is a contemporary design featuring a three-dimensional Laurel emblem achieved through a meticulous embossing technique. A lightweight die-cut EVA sole and removable OrthoLite® insole result in exquisite comfort.

product_name: Monogram Print Bikini
description: A highlight of our swimwear collection, this stretch bikini is embellished with the signature Visetos monogram print. The classic “MCM” letters bridge the bikini top through elegant logo hardware.

product_name: Laurel Flat Sandals in Lambskin
description: These flat sandals feature an Italian lamb leather upper embossed with the victorious laurel emblem. Artisanal comfort is achieved through a lamb leather lining and leather sole.

product_name: Aren Bifold Wallet with Card Case in Embossed Leather
description: Combining striking aesthetics with real-world utility, this leather wallet unfolds to reveal a color-blocked interior with classic compartments for your cards and cash. A removable card case adds another dimension of versatility and portability.
